messages:
emma (docs): quick heads-up linkcheck flagged a weird pattern: headings that follow fenced code blocks without a blank line are not getting IDs in the built site, causing a bunch of cross-page fragment failures. example: docs/sdk/snippets.md -> docs/sdk/overview#client-init is 404. noah (eng): can you paste the small markdown snippet that reproduces it? emma (docs): sure — in `snippets.md` we have:```js const c = new Client(); ``` ## Client init and the build output shows the heading text inside the `
` block instead of an `
`.

aj (devex): thats a CommonMark-ish edge. some parsers need a blank line between fences and following ATX headings. we can do three things: lint, autofix (in CI), or post-build repair.

lila (i18n): note: any auto-fix in source will touch translated files too. translators may not expect lines inserted. prefer post-build repairs for locales, or a per-locale lint check.

emma (docs): proposal: 1) add a markdownlint rule to catch "fence followed immediately by heading" (fail CI for docs PRs) 2) add a tiny post-build HTML repair that moves heading out of pre and assigns a slugified id if missing 3) i18n: run the repair in preview only and surface changes to translators for manual sign-off before we apply to locale source.

ci-bot: linkcheck: 7 broken anchors detected in PR preview (lc-2026-05-02-09). failing samples: /sdk/overview#client-init, /guides/auth#oauth-example.

aj (devex): I can add markdownlint rule MD### (custom) and an autofix that inserts a blank line after fenced blocks when safe. that should prevent new issues.

noah (eng): I'll add the post-build script — simple node script that searches for `
.*
